local util_cargo = require('Module:CargoUtil')
local rows = util_cargo.query{
	tables='Weapons=W, Locales=Uses, Locales=Descriptions',
	join = 'W.Weapon = Uses.Entity, W.Weapon = Descriptions.Entity',
	fields = 'W.Weapon=weapon, W.Rarity=rarity, Uses.Value=use, Descriptions.Value=description, W.Source=source',
	where = 'Uses.Lang = "en" AND Uses.Param = "use" AND Descriptions.Lang = "en" AND Descriptions.Param = "description"'
}
local data = {}
for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
	data[row.weapon] = {
		name = row.weapon,
		tier = row.rarity,
		use = row.use,
		desc = row.description,
		obtain = row.source,
		link = row.weapon,
		image = row.weapon..' icon',
	}
end

return data
